desc: Assemble the separately pinned LC1 Asahi 7.2.12-2 source candidate from 6002's map. Resolve raw-boot PMGR/AIC and duplicate DockChannel provider conflicts, retain proven J614s DT/input/split NVMe behavior, and produce a reviewed ordered patch series plus config/DT manifest. Offline source preparation only; no build, rig, enrollment or target writes. 6001 remains the next hardware action.
author: astra
acceptance_criteria: Use exact Asahi 2bb9d16f967f11e533a851b13b148a708d59b4f3 and 6002 local-source/patch pins; preserve dirty shared source checkout.
Produce ordered patch files for AIC and PMGR, exactly one legacy mailbox FIFO provider plus proven HID v2/TTY, BSS116 and gated split NVMe; no wholesale Yuka DT import.
Review complete config/DT/resource diff and compiler-facing API dependencies; use idle=nop arm64.nowfxt and maxcpus=1. No p3s/KVM/loader/USB/SPMI/display or new firmware changes.
Pin assembled source series and unresolved issues; create a separate scoped build follow-on only after source gates close. No build or rig work in 6004; 6001 remains next hardware step.
